name: Crawlspace
tagline: Find out where crawlers get stuck.
about:
Crawlspace is a free set of SEO skills for Claude Code. It walks a site the way a crawler does, fetching every page raw and rendered, reads the code that made them, and proves each finding.

The mark is a crawl map: the root page and two links, with the one where the crawler got stuck flagged in amber.
construction: On a 256 grid: an equilateral triangle of side 160 with its apex at (128, 52), nodes of radius 30 on its corners and two edges 16 wide; the base is left open, because a crawl map is a tree.

colors.name: Blueprint
colors.usage: The page, the brand field and the icon tile: Crawlspace lives on Blueprint first.

colors.name: Survey
colors.usage: The mark and brand-coloured text on light grounds.

colors.name: Flag
colors.usage: The flagged node and one highlight per layout (a finding, a call to action); never body text on light grounds.

colors.name: Tracing
colors.usage: Light pages, and the wordmark on Blueprint.

colors.name: Signal
colors.usage: The mark on Blueprint, and primary buttons in both themes (with Blueprint labels).

portfolio.alt: A site map drawn on blueprint paper, its pages joined by dashed lines, with a cyan trail running from the root down every branch until it stops at one page ringed in amber, and the two pages behind it still grey and unreached.
